\section[das Büro]{das Büro — an office}

\label{lesson:GE-C107-buero}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the German for a stadium, then the German for a factory.

Say \emph{die Jahre}, the plural of \emph{das Jahr}. And remember that German IS its years: \emph{ich bin}, not \emph{ich habe}.
\end{quote}
